command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state; echo '=== package ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path --user 0 moe.shizuku.privileged.api || true; echo '=== process ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A | grep -Ei 'shizuku|rikka' || true; echo '=== focus ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys window | grep -E 'mCurrentFocus|mFocusedApp' | head -n 6 || true; echo '=== explicit play ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d 'market://details?id=moe.shizuku.privileged.api' -p com.android.vending 2>&1 || true; sleep 4; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/window.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/window.xml 2>/dev/null | tr '<' '
<' | grep -Ei 'Shizuku|Zainstaluj|Install|Otwórz|Open|Aktualizuj|Update' | head -n 120 || true; echo phase2c_check_shizuku_now_complete=true
